name: Data centre CRAH/CRAC room cooling (air side)
description: Per-hall air handlers that close the loop between the cold aisle and the heat-rejection plant: computer-room air handlers (CRAH, chilled water) and air conditioners (CRAC, direct expansion), now joined by water-free pumped-refrigerant economisers. The Vertiv Liebert DSE spans 50-165 kW per unit (packaged systems to about 400 kW) and provides free cooling with no water — a chilled-water plant serving 1 MW of IT load uses roughly 4 million gallons of water a year that the DSE avoids.

subtypes.name: CRAH (chilled water air handler)
subtypes.description: Coil-and-fan units fed by the chilled-water plant; the classic air-side workhorse.

subtypes.name: CRAC (direct expansion)
subtypes.description: Self-contained refrigeration units; simpler plant, lower efficiency at scale.

subtypes.name: Pumped-refrigerant economiser (free cooling)
subtypes.description: Water-free systems such as the Liebert DSE that reject heat without compressors when ambient allows.
